'Gain 1{h} / If you've been dealt arcane damage this turn, INSTEAD gain 2{h}.'

'INSTEAD' MEANS ONE GAIN, NOT TWO. Authored as an unconditional GAIN 1 followed by a conditional GAIN 2 the card would heal 3 -- so the whole thing is one CONDITIONAL_EFFECT with a then/else, and exactly one branch runs.

'BEEN DEALT' IS THE VICTIM'S SIDE. effect_keywords records two separate markers on purpose: `damage` on the player who DEALT it and `damage_taken` on the one who received it. Asking the `damage` marker here would give the attacker's answer to the defender's question -- true whenever YOU had dealt arcane damage, which is the opposite card.
